{"assessments":[{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选清楚说明连麦后会先判断学员问题，再按针对性的步骤提出改进方向；但前段口误、闲聊和催互动占比较多，核心观点出现较晚。","candidate_id":"candidate_a1d7354902e340e6","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"声乐改进需要先通过连麦判断个人问题，再按合适的步骤针对性纠正。","risk_summary":"内容包含灯牌连麦及课程服务引导，发布时需审视推广属性。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"声乐连麦诊断与纠正步骤","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选包含对唱歌与说话状态差异的简短交流，并用演唱作进一步尝试；诊断结论没有在本段内说出，歌词转写也有明显损坏。","candidate_id":"candidate_27e8574669b9e0c2","content_risk_flags":["copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","context_dependency","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"演唱者希望通过再唱几句，让老师进一步判断唱歌时的发声问题。","risk_summary":"歌词涉及第三方作品，且转写不稳，核心诊断依赖段外内容并未完成。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"通过追加演唱诊断发声问题","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选以一段演唱为主，随后出现老师肯定并询问其助唱经历，能够形成表演加简短反馈的单位；部分话语转写含混，具体评价依据不充分。","candidate_id":"candidate_f262b8f87ac47de0","content_risk_flags":["copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"老师认可这段演唱，并进一步询问演唱者是否有外出演唱经历。","risk_summary":"演唱内容可能涉及第三方作品，且个别反馈用语转写不清。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"演唱展示与助唱经历交流","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选几乎完全由歌曲演唱构成，情绪和意象连续，能够作为表演片段理解；但没有教学反馈或独立观点，且若脱离音乐画面，文本价值有限。","candidate_id":"candidate_59b038f803f24532","content_risk_flags":["copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"演唱片段以冲突、沉默和相互背离的意象表达感情纠缠。","risk_summary":"主体为歌曲演唱内容，可能涉及第三方作品权益。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"情感歌曲演唱片段","uncertainty_flags":["claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"开头以跑调纪录缓解演唱者紧张，随后进入歌曲演唱，具备轻松互动和表演过程；演唱转写较乱，且没有形成后续评价。","candidate_id":"candidate_8e329a9311a36567","content_risk_flags":["copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"主播用夸张的跑调纪录安慰紧张的演唱者，随后让其开始演唱。","risk_summary":"歌曲内容可能涉及第三方作品，演唱转写不稳且本段缺少完整反馈。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"缓解紧张后的现场演唱","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选先完成歌曲演唱，再自然转入设备和地域交流，老师明确判断演唱本身没有明显问题；但关键的地域发声分析尚未在本段展开。","candidate_id":"candidate_059b8bf41086721a","content_risk_flags":["copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"老师认为这次演唱整体没有明显问题，并从口音线索判断演唱者来自川渝地区。","risk_summary":"包含第三方歌曲内容，且有关地域口音的后续解释在本段中未完成。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"演唱反馈与川渝口音判断","uncertainty_flags":["missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选明确介绍直播间以上麦声乐教学为主，并承诺快速指出和解决音乐问题，信息完整且有直接行动号召；大量点赞、关注和灯牌引导削弱了教学密度。","candidate_id":"candidate_3f73ee8bb04ee052","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"观众可以通过连麦提出声乐问题，主播会快速指出问题并给出改进方向。","risk_summary":"内容带有密集的关注、灯牌和连麦推广，且少量词语存在转写误差。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"声乐教学直播的连麦方式","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选给出针对该学员的明确建议：录播课不足以解决问题，需要逐字、按歌纠正，并说明线上课程有录屏和效果承诺；教学建议与销售话术交织。","candidate_id":"candidate_1d0bcd4f6ed22861","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"对需要细改咬字的学员，逐字按歌曲进行针对性指导比单看录播更有效。","risk_summary":"内容包含课程招揽、录屏服务和退费承诺，具有明显推广属性。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"逐字纠正咬字与线上课程推广","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选是一段连续演唱，能够作为表演片段识别，情绪表达较统一；但转写存在错词，没有评价、解释或完整故事收束。","candidate_id":"candidate_84a0a525d56ff5bd","content_risk_flags":["copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"演唱片段围绕关系疏离和停止伪装的情绪展开。","risk_summary":"主体可能为第三方歌曲内容，且歌词转写存在不确定性。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"关系疏离主题的歌曲演唱","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选先反馈学员第二节课后的进步空间，随后转为连麦、灯牌和主播互动，最后提出狗喘气练习问题却没有作答；话题较散，教学承诺未闭合。","candidate_id":"candidate_374a9f9e7e085c59","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"学员仍有较大提升空间，应继续循序学习，但本段提出的狗喘气训练标准尚未得到解释。","risk_summary":"内容含密集灯牌推广，且关于狗喘气训练的问题在本段没有完成回答。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"学员进步反馈与呼吸练习提问","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics","missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选尝试说明唱歌有不同发声通道，并把直接使用说话通道与高音受阻联系起来；核心教学只讲到第一个通道便被互动和灯牌话题打断，且转写重复明显。","candidate_id":"candidate_2e039a3e91689484","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"直接沿用日常说话的发声通道，可能使高音演唱受到限制。","risk_summary":"发声通道解释因转写重复和话题中断而不完整，并夹杂灯牌推广。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"说话通道与高音受阻","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选主要是一段短歌唱展示，情绪表达可辨认；没有本段内的点评或明确结论，且若不知道前面的请求，独立成片的信息量较低。","candidate_id":"candidate_9d47bf21dc719613","content_risk_flags":["copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","context_dependency"],"primary_claim":"演唱片段表达两人逐渐成为过客、关系趋于熄灭的情绪。","risk_summary":"主体可能为第三方歌曲内容，部分歌词转写不稳，表演动机依赖前文。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"关系走向疏离的歌曲演唱","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选以吸气和呼气示范引出唱歌时气流与腹部变化，具备可理解的教学动作；中途插入点赞目标，且腹部变化的答案要到后文才完整说明。","candidate_id":"candidate_eda02f3bbfbc7462","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"可以通过吸气、呼气示范观察唱歌时气流与腹部状态的变化。","risk_summary":"教学结论在本段尚未完整落下，并夹有点赞换教学环节的推广话术。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"唱歌呼吸与腹部状态示范","uncertainty_flags":["missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选从演唱实例过渡到明确诊断，指出声音缺乏穿透力和厚度，并由演唱者补充鼻腔挂位后使不上劲的感受；原因与改法尚需后文补全。","candidate_id":"candidate_8ba2743da2b9cb9e","content_risk_flags":["copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"演唱者当前声音缺少穿透力和厚度，并在采用鼻腔挂位后感到难以发力。","risk_summary":"开头含第三方歌曲内容，诊断虽清楚但具体成因和解决方式尚未在本段完成。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"声音穿透力、厚度与发力困难","uncertainty_flags":["missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选从提胸问题转向年龄、肌肉和机能变化，再回到健身互动，能辨认出鼓励锻炼的观点；年龄界线和身体变化的断言缺少本段内依据，且末尾被现场调灯打断。","candidate_id":"candidate_e2c68e2187b0dda3","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"主播认为成年人应保持适度锻炼，以应对随年龄出现的肌肉和身体机能变化。","risk_summary":"涉及具体年龄与肌肉、机能退化的健康断言，部分相关词语转写不清，发布前需核验。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"年龄变化与日常锻炼建议","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"}]}
